paper.title_en: Evaporating Black Hole Interior and Complexity Evolution
paper.abstract_en: We study the evolution of the interior of an evaporating black hole in a simple model of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with an end-of-the-world (EoW) brane, where evaporation is modeled by entangling the brane's internal states with an auxiliary radiation system. To probe the black hole interior, we consider a geodesic length extracted from a boundary-to-brane two-point function and interpret its renormalised value as a measure of subsystem complexity. Our computation, based on quenched disorder averaging, includes non-perturbative gravitational effects from both spacetime wormholes and replica wormholes, encoding ensemble averaging over the dual random Hamiltonian and brane-state couplings. Unlike non-evaporating black holes, for which complexity first grows linearly and then plateaus at late times $\sim{\cal O}(e^{S_{\rm BH}})$, we find that complexity evolution of the black hole subsystem in the evaporating case differs drastically, depending nontrivially on the dimension of the emitted radiation Hilbert space. It grows linearly at early times, reaches a maximum shortly before the Page-time crossover $\sim{\cal O}({S_{\rm BH}})$, and then decays exponentially. We further show that the relative fluctuations of the interior length remain small before the Page time but become of order one and eventually large at later times: this signals a loss of self-averaging, with the ensemble-averaged complexity dominated by rare configurations rather than by typical realisations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在带EoW膜的JT引力模型中研究蒸发黑洞内部结构的演化，结合淬火无序平均、时空虫洞与副本虫洞等非微扰效应，考察以边界-膜两点函数提取的测地线长度作为子系统复杂度度量。研究对象与黑洞热力学及全息方向高度契合，技术工具（JT引力、副本虫洞、Page时间、自平均性丧失）具有较强的理论深度，并给出与不蒸发情形截然不同的复杂度演化图像以及涨落从微小到量级为1的转变，结果具有非平凡的新意。摘要结构清晰，方法、假设与结果均有交代。综合判断值得点击阅读全文。
decision.title_zh: 蒸发黑洞内部与复杂度演化
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在一个带有世界终结（EoW）膜的Jackiw-Teitelboim（JT）引力的简单模型中研究蒸发黑洞内部的演化，其中蒸发是通过将膜的内部态与一个辅助辐射系统纠缠来建模的。为了探测黑洞内部，我们考虑从一个边界到膜的两点函数中提取的测地线长度，并将其重整化后的值解释为子系统复杂度的一种度量。我们的计算基于淬火无序平均，包含了来自时空虫洞和副本虫洞的非微扰引力效应，编码了对偶随机哈密顿量以及膜-态耦合的系综平均。与不蒸发黑洞（其复杂度先线性增长，然后在晚期约$\sim{\cal O}(e^{S_{\rm BH}})$处达到平台）不同，我们发现蒸发情形下黑洞子系统的复杂度演化截然不同，它非平凡地依赖于所发射辐射希尔伯特空间的维度。它在早期线性增长，在Page时间交叉之前不久约$\sim{\cal O}({S_{\rm BH}})$处达到最大值，随后指数衰减。我们进一步表明，内部长度的相对涨落在Page时间之前保持很小，但在更晚时期变为量级为1并最终变得很大：这标志着自平均性的丧失，系综平均复杂度由稀有构型而非典型实现所主导。
